speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic. I understand you are experiencing episodic cough and shortness of breath; to begin our evaluation, how long have these symptoms been occurring?

speaker: Patient
text: 59-year-old female. The patient reports a 1-month history of episodic cough and shortness of breath. The cough is nonproductive and worsens when climbing stairs and at night. She experienced fever, sore throat, and nasal congestion 8 weeks ago.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for the details. Given the recent upper respiratory symptoms and your age, was the cough preceded by a distinct "whooping" sound, or do you feel a tickle in your throat before coughing?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Episodic cough and shortness of breath. I also have Cough worsens with exertion and at night, History of recent upper respiratory tract infection symptoms such as fever, sore throat, and nasal congestion.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Post-infectious Cough (likely Pertussis or Post-viral Cough)
